name: rode-battery
title: RODE Connect battery reader
description: The rode-battery app (~/code/rode-battery, outside this repository) screen-reads the RODE Connect window and posts each capture — per microphone: connected, battery percent, pill color — as a non-persisted rode_status frame via POST /api/chat/events. The server keeps only the latest reading and serves it at GET /api/rode for Talon Voice and other local consumers.

fields.name: status
fields.description: capture state: ok, permission-denied, app-not-running, window-missing or read-error — never conflate an error with a real 0%

fields.name: channels
fields.description: per-microphone readings, present only when status is ok: an array of {mic, label, connected, pct, color, confidence}; mic is the channel id (tx1, tx2), pct is 0..100 or null when disconnected or unreadable, color is green, amber, red or unknown, confidence is 0..1

fields.name: detail
fields.description: optional human-readable detail for non-ok states
